2610.10498.title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
2610.10498.paper_summary: Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolution. The Slow System builds Hierarchical Memory, and Reward-Grounded Memory Learning selects effective memory according to their value for later Fast-System improvement. On RoboCasa365, EmbodiedRSI reaches 77.0% overall success and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen, compared with 40.1% for the best baseline. EmbodiedRSI also reaches 86.8% overall success on LIBERO-Pro. Beyond benchmark performance, EmbodiedRSI transfers zero-shot to real-world robot, achieving 71.3% overall success across multiple challenging tasks.
2610.10498.paper_summary_zh: 機器人基礎模型提供強大的視覺運動控制，但當物體位置或任務指令改變時，其性能可能會下降。進一步的改進通常需要在大量機器人數據上進行後訓練，而這通過如遠程操作等方法收集數據可能會非常昂貴。代理式鞍具可以圍繞模型進行調整，但目前的自我演化鞍具在決定追求哪些代碼和技能變更時效率不高。我們介紹了EmbodiedRSI，一種自我演化的代理式鞍具，能夠自主決定下一步探索的方向，並將結果的物理互動轉化為改進的代碼和技能。EmbodiedRSI通過快速-緩慢雙系統架構實現這一點，其中競爭的代碼和技能假設保存在假設圖中。信息價值實驗選擇選擇能夠區分這些假設的物理實驗。它們的結果指導代碼-技能共同演化。緩慢系統構建層次記憶，而基於獎勵的記憶學習根據其對後續快速系統改進的價值選擇有效的記憶。在RoboCasa365上，EmbodiedRSI達到了77.0%的整體成功率和71.3%的Composite-Unseen成功率，而最佳基準為40.1%。EmbodiedRSI在LIBERO-Pro上也達到了86.8%的整體成功率。除了基準性能外，EmbodiedRSI還能零樣本轉移到現實世界的機器人，實現了71.3%的整體成功率，涵蓋多個具有挑戰性的任務。
